name: Lambda Labs
tagline: Lambda Labs provides GPU cloud instances and deep learning workstations for AI researchers and teams. Its on-demand and reserved A100/H100 instances offer competitive pricing for training large models. Lambda also manufactures GPU workstations used by top research labs and AI startups for on-premise training.
